[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use evidence-based arguments and avoid using emotional appeals or personal attacks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Be open-minded and willing to change your own views if presented with new information.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Stay respectful and maintain a calm tone, even if the conversation becomes heated.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Take breaks if needed to avoid becoming emotional or frustrated.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] End the conversation respectfully, even if you don't reach a consensus.
